documents.text: a Whig and sat in the House of Commons as Member of Parliament for Ashburton between 1754 and 1761 , and for Shoreham between 1761 and 1765 . [ 1 ] In 1762 he commissioned Sir William Chambers to build a mansion on his estate at Peper Harow in Surrey . He died before it was complete and his son completed it once he came of age . The house is now a Grade I listed building . [ 2 ] He died of an abscess in the spleen on 22 August 1765 and was buried six days later at
